about: Run memory per repository and app, stage 1: the agent never starts from zero. What one run learns and the platform verified goes into the next run's phase brief as information, never as a permission (a rule that loosens anything needs four-eyes review, not this store). Read by workflow_runs/run_memory; the entries live on the repository record (config_json.run_memory.<app folder>).

test_command.about: A command that exited 0 in the platform's own pipeline for this app (verified).

environment_fix.about: An environment error that paused a run, and the commands of the next green pipeline that ran past it.

denial_alternative.about: A tool call the platform refused, and the first call of the same tool it allowed after that in the same phase pass.

large_output.about: A Bash command whose output was at least large_output_kb in a measured turn, and a later run of the same command (same first two words) in that turn that printed at most short_output_kb.

app_fact.about: A fact about the app the platform verified on the base commit, for the hands-on scenario writer (data_not_persistent: a seed's data was gone after a restart; setup:<step>: a setup step that failed on the base).
